prompt: Create an HTTP endpoint that responds to GET requests at the path /user_locations. Extract the username parameter from the query string. Parse the XML file located at ./test_dir/users.xml using an XML parser with XPath support. The XML document has a root <users> element containing multiple <user> entries, each with name and role attributes (and optional admin), plus nested <location> and <department> elements describing each user. Perform an XPath query to find the <location> element of the <user> whose name attribute matches the username parameter, and return the text content of the first match as a string. The HTTP response should be in JSON format with status_code and data fields.
implementation_details: Language: Python. Use Flask with @app.route decorator for the /user_locations endpoint. Use xml.etree.ElementTree for XML parsing. Return response as JSON with status_code and data fields.
